newsitem.title: INDONESIA: China's defence minister to attend Deng funeral.
newsitem.headline: China's defence minister to attend Deng funeral.

text.p: Chinese Defence Minister Chi Haotian will leave Indonesia on Monday, a day early, to attend the funeral of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping in Beijing, an Indonesian Defence Ministry spokesman said on Friday.
"Chi is scheduled to leave Indonesia on February 24 and will directly fly to China to attend Deng Xiaoping's funeral," the spokesman told Reuters.
He said Chi would miss a meeting with Indonesian President Suharto which had been scheduled for Tuesday following Suharto's return from a Southeast Asian tour.
A Chinese embassy official confirmed the change in Chi's itinerary but declined to give further details.
Chi arrived in Jakarta on Thursday for a five-day visit at the invitation of Indonesian Defence Minister Edi Sudradjat.
Deng died late on Wednesday from respiratory failure. He was 92.
